_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

beats.role: one cell, addressed — index to position
mirror and symmetry on the grid
prove it — reproduce a target pattern

voltage.why: the grid as the WEAVE — threading, tie-up, treadling; the addressable array is centuries-old textile labor, mostly women's, that computation quietly inherited and renamed.
the array read as TIME, not space — a playhead sweeping indices turns the row into rhythm; index is not neutral coordinate but sequence, order, before-and-after.
the pattern becomes ARCHITECTURE you stand inside — the grid stops being a diagram you look at and becomes a room that surrounds you, the tiling as inhabited ideology.
the grid as a DATA IMAGE with a history — stacked pulsar sweeps (1967) became Joy Division's cover; repetition on a grid is never innocent formatting, it is how we choose to see a signal.
